description: Contract for the kiosk Calendar feature. ChatWonder uses this to understand what calendar events look like, what actions it can dispatch, and what context the Calendar page sends back.

eventShape.id: string — uuid generated by the frontend on creation
eventShape.title: string — eventName collected in event-setup
eventShape.eventType: string — one of: casual | formal | business | romantic | outdoor | party | sports | other
eventShape.dateTime: ISO 8601 string (e.g. 2026-05-20T19:00:00) — collected in event-setup datetime step
eventShape.location: string — human-readable location collected in event-setup location step
eventShape.createdAt: ISO 8601 string — timestamp when the event was saved to the calendar

actions.description: Create and display a new event in the Calendar. Usually triggered after event-setup confirmation.
Ask the Calendar page to focus on a specific date and display its events
Remove an event from the Calendar by its id

payload.id: string — uuid of the event to remove

pageContext.description: Fields sent as collectedData / pageContext from the Calendar page with every chatwonder_input

fields.selectedDate: ISO 8601 date string (YYYY-MM-DD) — the date currently in focus on the calendar view
fields.events: array of eventShape — all events visible in the current calendar view

dataFlow.action: calendar_save_event dispatched by ChatWonder → Calendar feature stores and displays the event
